title: Top 10 Sanitaryware Manufacturers in India
description: Here's a brief overview of India's top 10 sanitaryware manufacturers, showcasing their products and standout features in this competitive industry.
bodyHtml:
Since India’s real estate market has grown rapidly and hygiene standards have increased, sanitaryware has become one of the most essential components of new buildings and renovations. You can choose sanitaryware from various brands that are vying for your attention. Selecting the right sanitaryware goes beyond functionality; it aims to improve your space’s aesthetics, maximize its durability, and integrate cutting-edge technology. Whether a homeowner or a professional, finding the right solution to meet your needs means balancing quality, innovation, and sustainability. As a leading brand shaping the industry, Prayag India aims to showcase its unique strengths as a sanitaryware manufacturer in India’s highly competitive marketplace.

Several highly respected legacy brands and newer players are bringing innovative products. Each manufacturer brings something of their own to the market. Indian sanitaryware manufacturers have extended their offerings beyond primary products, integrating new technologies focusing on water conservation, user comfort, and smart home compatibility. Here’s an in-depth look at India’s top 10 sanitaryware manufacturers, providing insights into their products, exceptional features, and why they stand out in this competitive field.

1. Prayag

Prayag is one of the top Sanitaryware Manufacturers in India & has built a reputation over its 35 years as a pioneer in sanitaryware manufacturing and bath fittings, standing out as one of India’s most trusted brands. The company is notably recognized for introducing PTMT (Polytetra Methylene Terephthalate) technology, which is associated with durability and high performance in Indian homes and commercial spaces. PTMT products are known for their exceptional resistance to staining and scratching, making them ideal for long-lasting installations in frequently used environments, such as hotels, hospitals, and public spaces.

Prayag’s vast product portfolio spans over 4,500 items, covering everything from faucets and shower fittings to kitchen sinks, basins, water heaters, and storage tanks. The brand’s faucets and fittings come in various designs, catering to traditional and stylish aesthetics. Each product is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring functionality meets style, a combination valued by architects, interior designers, and homeowners alike.

Prayag India continues to set new standards in sanitaryware. Their commitment to quality and innovation has made them a go-to choice for Indian consumers looking for products that promote everyday living.

2. Jaquar

For over six decades, Jaquar has been a household name in India’s sanitaryware market, renowned for its high-quality faucets, showers, and stylish sanitaryware that combine function and elegance. Jaquar offers faucets in diverse finishes like chrome and antique bronze and a wellness range featuring whirlpools, steam cabins, and customizable shower solutions. Their innovative bathroom products incorporate sensor-based technology, enhancing user convenience while prioritizing sustainability. With water-saving designs, Jaquar remains a top choice for eco-conscious buyers seeking innovation and dependability in bathroom solutions.

3. Hindware

Hindware, a trusted name in Indian sanitaryware since 1960, is renowned for its commitment to innovation and quality. With a diverse product range that includes basins (counter, wall-mounted, and tabletop options), water-efficient closets and urinals, kitchen sinks in various sizes and finishes, and high-quality faucets featuring auto shut-off and easy-cleaning capabilities, Hindware continues to impress consumers across the country. Their dedication to design and functionality is apparent in stylish products that seamlessly blend with both contemporary and traditional aesthetics, making Hindware a preferred sanitaryware manufacturer for Indian households and commercial spaces alike.

4. Cera

Cera is a famous sanitaryware manufacturer in India that is a choice for consumers seeking trendy design and lasting durability. Cera offers a wide range of products, from sanitaryware and faucets to tiles and wellness solutions, delivering on both style and functionality. Their product lineup includes designer basins in unusual shapes and sizes, wall-hung and floor-mounted toilets, bidet systems, and urinals featuring water-saving technology. Cera also provides a comprehensive selection of shower cubicles and enclosures, catering to diverse aesthetic preferences. With a strong focus on innovation, Cera has evolved into a go-to brand for customers who want distinctive products that elevate the look and feel of their spaces.

5. Parryware

With over many years of experience, Parryware is renowned for delivering quality and affordability, making it a preferred choice, especially for budget-conscious residential projects. Their range includes affordable water closets, basins, hardy CP fittings, mixers, and functional yet aesthetic sanitaryware solutions. Parryware’s ability to balance cost-effectiveness with dedicated quality has earned it a strong reputation and solidified its place as a trusted sanitaryware manufacturer in India for projects on a budget.

6. Roca

Roca, a global leader in sanitaryware, has established a strong presence in India. It is known for delivering high-quality, elegantly designed products that cater to the premium segment. Their offerings include sleek and modern basins, semi-recessed and pedestal types, and water-saving toilets that highlight sustainability.

Roca also provides innovative shower and bath solutions and stylish bathroom furniture and accessories. With a keen focus on aesthetics and functionality, Roca has become one of India’s top manufacturers of luxury bathroom solutions.

7. Kohler

Kohler, an American brand with a strong presence in India, has become synonymous with luxury and premium quality in bathroom solutions. Known for unique designs, Kohler offers an array of high-end products that appeal to discerning consumers, including designer bathtubs in freestanding and built-in styles, sophisticated faucets and fixtures in a variety of finishes, and elegant toilets equipped with advanced flushing technology for water efficiency. Kohler’s commitment to innovation and luxury makes it a top choice for those seeking refined and durable bathroom products.

8. American Standard

American Standard delivers international quality and design to the Indian market, demonstrating itself as a leader with advanced hygiene solutions that cater to modern households and commercial spaces. The brand offers unique products, including water closets with integrated bidet functions, water-efficient faucets and basins, and modern bath and shower systems, all crafted with a strong focus on user comfort and hygiene. This adherence to innovation and functionality has earned American Standard a distinct position in India’s sanitaryware industry.

9. Somany

Somany Ceramics, recognized for quality and innovation, has become a top sanitaryware manufacturer in India. Offering basins, water closets, and bathroom accessories, Somany blends aesthetics with functionality. Known for integrating advanced water efficiency and hygiene technologies, Somany’s products cater to residential and commercial needs. With a trusted reputation and wide distribution, Somany is preferred in India’s sanitaryware market.

10. Johnson Pedder.

Established in 1978, Johnson Pedder has become a leading name in India’s sanitaryware industry. As part of the Roca Group since 2007, the company offers a comprehensive range of bathroom solutions, including sanitaryware, faucets, and accessories. Johnson Pedder is known for its commitment to quality and affordability, making it a preferred choice for residential and commercial projects. Their vast product portfolio caters to diverse customer preferences, combining functionality with contemporary design.

What Sets Prayag Apart in Sanitaryware

When it comes to sanitaryware, Prayag has established itself as a reliable choice for Indian consumers seeking top-quality products from a trusted sanitaryware manufacturer in India. With over 35 years of experience, Prayag offers a wide range of products that combine quality, durability, and innovation. As a leading sanitaryware manufacturer, their unique PTMT technology and comprehensive product range make them a preferred choice for customers looking for reliable and stylish solutions. Whether you’re looking to outfit a new home or upgrade an existing bathroom, Prayag has products to meet your needs.

Get in Touch: Visit Prayag India and connect with a representative today to explore Prayag’s latest offerings and discover how their products can enhance your space.
